hooks.command: P="${DEVIN_PLUGIN_ROOT}"; if [ -x "$P/hooks/run.sh" ]; then "$P/hooks/run.sh" session-start || true; elif command -v bro >/dev/null 2>&1; then ( exec 3<&0; bro hooks session-start <&3 3<&- & c=$!; ( for i in 1 2 3 4 5 6 7 8; do kill -0 "$c" 2>/dev/null || exit 0; sleep 1; done; kill "$c" 2>/dev/null; pkill -TERM -P "$c" 2>/dev/null; sleep 1; kill -9 "$c" 2>/dev/null ) >/dev/null 2>&1 & w=$!; wait "$c" 2>/dev/null; wait "$w" 2>/dev/null ) || true; fi; exit 0
